source_refs.note: 1.1.2 Operations on Complex Numbers, definitions (i)-(iv) (book p. 2); PDF 7-7.

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke complex numbers ko jama (addition), tafreeq (subtraction) aur zarb (multiplication) kaise karte hain, aur kisi real number se complex number ko kaise zarb dete hain. Pichle sabaq mein aap ne real part aur imaginary part pehchanna seekha tha; ab yahi pehchan har operation mein kaam aayegi, kyunke har rule mein hum real hisson ko real hisson ke saath aur imaginary hisson ko imaginary hisson ke saath jodte hain.

Ab complex numbers ka algebra banane ke liye kitab kuch definitions deti hai. Jahan bhi \(a, b, c, d, k\) symbols aayein, woh real numbers hain. Pehle chaaron rules dekh lijiye, phir hum har ek ko samjhenge.

items: Real number se zarb: \[k(a+ib) = ka + ikb\]

blocks.text: Ab har rule ko ek ek kar ke samajhte hain. Addition mein soch bilkul wohi hai jo algebra mein \(2x + 3y\) aur \(4x + 5y\) jama karte waqt hoti hai: \(x\) wale \(x\) ke saath, \(y\) wale \(y\) ke saath. Yahan real part (\(a\) aur \(c\)) ek saath jama hote hain aur \(i\) wale hisse (\(b\) aur \(d\)) ek saath. Yun samjhiye jaise do dukaanon ka hisaab: rupay rupay mein jama hote hain aur paise paise mein; dono ko mila nahi dete.
Rule (ii) mein real number \(k\) bracket ke dono hisson ko zarb deta hai, bilkul distributive law ki tarah. Misaal: \(3(2 + 5i) = 6 + 15i\).

Subtraction ko kitab "negative jama karna" ki tarah define karti hai: \(z_1 - z_2\) ka matlab hai \(z_1 + (-z_2)\). Yahan sab se ahem qadam \(-(c + id) = -c - id\) hai: minus ka sign bracket ke andar dono hisson par lagta hai. Is ke baad wahi addition ka rule chal jata hai, aur jawab \((a - c) + i(b - d)\) aata hai.

Multiplication mein hum dono brackets ko waise hi kholte hain jaise algebra mein \((x + y)(p + q)\) kholte hain: pehle bracket ka har term doosre bracket ke har term se zarb. Is se chaar terms bante hain: \(ac\), \(iad\), \(ibc\) aur \(i^2bd\). Ab yahan ruk kar dekhiye: \(i^2 = -1\), is liye \(i^2bd\) ban jata hai \(-bd\). Yeh real number hai, to yeh real hisse mein \(ac\) ke saath chala jata hai. Isi wajah se product ka real part \(ac - bd\) hai, minus ke saath. Yahi ek jagah hai jahan complex numbers ka algebra aam algebra se thora alag hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh rules kahan se aaye? Koi naya qanoon nahi: \(i\) ko algebra ka ek aam letter samjhiye aur like terms (milte julte terms) ikatthe kijiye; real hisse real ke saath, imaginary hisse imaginary ke saath. Sirf ek naya fact istemaal hota hai: \(i^2 = -1\).
Multiplication mein \(i^2bd\) term \(-bd\) ban jata hai. Isi liye product ka real part \(ac - bd\) hai, \(ac + bd\) nahi.
Subtraction ko negative jama karne ki tarah define kiya gaya hai: \(-(c + id) = -c - id\). Dono hisson ka sign badalta hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal kitab ki nahi, hamari taraf se hai. Maan lijiye \(z_1 = 2 + 3i\) aur \(z_2 = 4 - 5i\).
Sum: real hisse \(2 + 4\), imaginary hisse \(3 + (-5)\):
\[z_1 + z_2 = (2+4) + i(3-5)\] \[= 6 - 2i\]
Difference: dhyan dein, \(3 - (-5) = 3 + 5 = 8\):
\[z_1 - z_2 = (2-4) + i(3-(-5))\] \[= -2 + 8i\]
Real multiple: 3 dono hisson ko zarb deta hai:
\[3z_1 = 6 + 9i\]
Product: chaar terms banayein, phir \(i^2 = -1\) lagayein:
\[z_1 z_2 = 8 - 10i + 12i - 15i^2\] \[= 8 + 15 + 2i\] \[= 23 + 2i\]
Dekhiye, \(-15i^2\) ban gaya \(+15\), kyunke \(-15 \times (-1) = +15\).

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Division (taqseem) is list mein nahi hai. \(c + id\) se taqseem karne ke liye hum upar aur neeche dono ko us ke conjugate \(c - id\) se zarb dete hain, kyunke \((c + id)(c - id) = c^2 + d^2\) real number hai. Is tarah neeche se \(i\) khatam ho jata hai. Yeh aap 1.1.4 (Example 2) mein poori tafseel se dekhenge.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \((1 + i)(1 - i)\) kitna hoga? Pehle khud hal kijiye. Jawab: \(1 - i + i - i^2 = 1 + 1 = 2\). Dekha, ek number ko us ke conjugate se zarb diya to real number aaya.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Jama aur tafreeq mein real hisse alag aur imaginary hisse alag jama ya tafreeq hote hain.
2. \(k(a + ib) = ka + ikb\): real number dono hisson ko zarb deta hai.
3. Zarb mein dono brackets algebra ki tarah kholiye aur har \(i^2\) ki jagah \(-1\) likhiye.
4. \((a+ib)(c+id) = (ac-bd) + i(ad+bc)\); real part mein minus ka sign \(i^2 = -1\) se aata hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
Subtraction mein sirf pehla sign badalna: \((a+ib)-(c+id) \ne (a-c)+i(b+d)\). Minus bracket ke dono hisson par lagta hai.
Multiplication mein \(i^2 = -1\) bhool jana aur real part \(ac + bd\) likh dena. Har dafa \(i^2\) dekhte hi use \(-1\) se badal dijiye.
Sirf real ko real se aur imaginary ko imaginary se zarb de dena: \((a+ib)(c+id) \ne ac + ibd\). Beech ke do terms \(iad\) aur \(ibc\) bhi zaroori hain.
